ExamRoom.title: ExamRoom
ExamRoom.description: An online exam room created by a teacher for students to take tests online

roomCode.description: A unique 6-character code for students to enter the room

grade.description: Grade or target class level, e.g. Khối 12, 12A1

gradeClass.description: Grade or target class assigned, e.g. Khối 12, 10A1, 11A2, 12A1

targetClass.description: Target grade or specific class assigned, e.g. Khối 12, 10A1, 11A2, 12A1

status.description: Room status whether it is currently accepting submissions

teacherName.description: Name or contact of the teacher

allowReview.description: Whether students can review correct answers immediately after submission

examData.description: The full exam data structure including questions and parts

StudentSubmission.title: StudentSubmission
StudentSubmission.description: An online test submission from a student taking the exam in a room

studentId.description: Student ID or exam seat number (SBD)

score.description: Structured score object containing total, part1, part2, part3

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Global application settings such as Public App URL for student exam links

publicAppUrl.description: Public domain URL used for generating student exam links and QR codes

updatedAt.description: Last updated timestamp in ISO format

ExamQuestionChunk.title: ExamQuestionChunk
ExamQuestionChunk.description: A chunked batch of exam questions and compressed WebP/JPEG PDF slices stored in a subcollection to stay well under the 1MB Firestore document limit

part1Items.description: Batch of Part I questions with compressed slices

part2Items.description: Batch of Part II questions with compressed slices

part3Items.description: Batch of Part III questions with compressed slices

TeacherAccount.title: TeacherAccount
TeacherAccount.description: Admin or Teacher account with role-based permissions for exam creation and room management

fullName.description: Display full name of the teacher or admin

status.description: Whether the account is active or locked

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO format

/exam_rooms/{roomCode}.description: Standardized online exam rooms indexed by 4-digit roomCode

/exam_rooms/{roomCode}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked batches of questions and PDF image slices for an exam room

/exam_rooms/{roomCode}/question_chunks/{.description: Chunked batches of questions and PDF image slices for an exam room

/exams/{examId}.description: Published online exams indexed by 4-digit Room/Exam Code

/exams/{examId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked batches of questions for a published exam

/exams/{examId}/submissions/{submissionI.description: Student submissions and test results for a published exam

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Online exam rooms created by teachers

/rooms/{roomId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked batches of questions for an online room

/rooms/{roomId}/submissions/{submissionI.description: Student submissions and test results for a specific room

/settings/{settingId}.description: Application settings including Public App URL for student links

/users/{userId}.description: Super Admin and user accounts (e.g. users/admin)

/teacher_accounts/{accountId}.description: Granted teacher and admin accounts synchronized across devices
